verdict.rationale: First-party docs show HeyGen turning a script into lip-synced avatar video, with 500+ ready-made presenters or 1,100+ AI actors as stock options and custom avatars built from a photo or a 15-second video, explicitly without filming or a studio. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the script-to-avatar workflow (community evidence covers only dubbing), explicit documentation of the paste-a-script UI flow for non-API marketers.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio

citations.quote: A Photo Avatar is created from a single still image of a person. HeyGen animates the face, syncs lip movements to your script
One Custom Video Avatar, plus 500+ ready-made presenters
Create ads that look creator-made without filming. Pick from 1,100+ AI actors
Create a realistic AI digital twin from a 15 sec video with consistent identity, natural motion, and voice in 175+ languages.
We can update their lines as needed, without ever having to return to the studio.
